name: new_bank_v2_grabmyo_same_day_cross_user_v1
source_integrity: Verify each selected Day1 WFDB data/header file against official SHA256SUMS.txt before feature extraction
trial_aggregation: mean and standard deviation of twenty disjoint 250 ms windows per native recording
source_state: F0v2 noise thresholds from Day1 source-users Rest windows only; F2a and F3c fit Day1 source metadata only; no validation/final user's signal fits any feature state
classifier: StandardScaler plus LogisticRegression C=1 max_iter=2000 random_state=20260924 trained on Day1 source users only
selection: maximize pooled validation-subject macro-F1, break ties by lower pooled validation log loss; final subjects never select arms
scope: Same-day public eight-channel four-gesture cross-user transfer. Each user is disjoint across source, validation and descriptive final groups. Final users have appeared in prior project studies, so final is not a fresh project-wide holdout. Not user's 250 Hz device or live recognition.
